index.summary: Initial proposed requirement for 20260902-dogfood-usability-evidence.
Semantic agent results must have exactly one persisted owner in tasks.xml Task records.

requirement.statement: Every durable semantic execution fact 鈥?implementation summary, changed files, commit identities, executed commands, exit codes, findings, risks, review disposition, blockers, and handoff instructions 鈥?must have exactly one persisted owner in tasks.xml. The same semantic report must not be maintained in both tasks.xml and a durable Markdown or JSON report.
requirement.rationale: Dogfooding revealed agents naturally wrote detailed reports outside .dogdouspec/, duplicating Task state and making the iteration incomplete without an undocumented directory. Treating both external files and Task records as durable creates competing sources of truth.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.
Define a narrow external-evidence boundary for data intrinsically unsuitable for XML embedding.

requirement.statement: Data that is inherently too large or binary for managed XML (ETL traces, crash dumps, packages, screenshots, complete test logs, coverage bundles, benchmark datasets) may be stored in a repository-approved artifact system. The owning Task record must contain the semantic outcome and, when needed, a stable locator, digest, media kind, size, producer, and coverage relationship. Losing the payload may reduce audit depth but must not erase the iteration's semantic outcome.
requirement.rationale: Embedding complete logs, traces, or binaries in XML bloats managed documents and harms bounded XPath access. However, losing all reference to such evidence removes audit depth. The correct boundary is semantic ownership, not file format.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.
Remove any dependency on .agents/work-results/ for iteration recovery, review, or handoff.

requirement.statement: The workflow must remain recoverable after all temporary worker output is deleted. DogdouSpec must not reserve or standardize .agents/work-results/ as a canonical hierarchy, persistence boundary, or recovery dependency. Deleting every .agents/work-results/ directory must not affect validation, recovery, review, readiness, or handoff.
requirement.rationale: During dogfooding, agents wrote to .agents/work-results/ as a second persistence model, making handoff depend on non-authoritative files that could be absent in another worktree or later session.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.
Define Git checkpoint and handoff expectations for authoritative .dogdouspec/ state in Git-backed workspaces.

requirement.statement: A Git-backed Mode B workspace must checkpoint validated authoritative .dogdouspec/ state before: iteration activation or owner adoption; material requirement/acceptance/scope/dependency/replanning decisions; Task transfer/split/supersession/cancellation/completion/review disposition; handoff to another agent/worktree/host; pausing for external blockers; release/deployment/verification gates; and iteration confirmation or closure. DogdouSpec must never infer Git mutation authority. Untracked or dirty authoritative XML must be reported as locally durable but not transport-ready, naming the exact uncheckpointed files.
requirement.rationale: During dogfooding, valid product commits existed while active spec.xml and tasks.xml remained untracked. The implementation was committed but the governing iteration was not transport-ready, creating a handoff dependency on one worktree.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.
Keep documentation, generated guidance, Skill content, installation instructions, and CLI help consistent with implemented behavior.

requirement.statement: Before new porcelain or schema work: SKILL.md and generated AGENTS.md must state semantic results belong in Task records and no external report directory is authoritative; README and installation guidance must state managed .dogdouspec/ documents should be versioned while _tmp/ remains runtime-only; initialized _skill/README.md must explain result ownership, checkpoint responsibility, and Git authority boundaries; existing CLI help must not list proposed commands as available. Proposed porcelain must remain labeled as proposed in documentation until separately implemented and tested.
requirement.rationale: Dogfooding exposed that guidance surfaces were inconsistent with each other and with implemented behavior, causing agent confusion about result ownership, checkpoint responsibility, and authority boundaries.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.
Improve scope, review, revise, visibility, readiness, and aggregation UX without weakening schema or authority gates.

requirement.statement: Implement phased usability improvements: Phase 1 鈥?task list/show/summary, task scope explain with --worktree mode, readiness dimension reporting, read-only workspace vcs-status and workspace checkpoint-plan. Phase 2 鈥?task review approve, task review request-changes, and additive task revise. Phase 3 (conditional) 鈥?minimal schema evolution for external raw-payload references only if dogfood demand remains. Phase 4 鈥?bounded read-only workspace aggregation over explicitly named roots. All commands must preserve expected revisions, reviewer separation, immutable terminal states, and raw XML fallback.
requirement.rationale: Several common activities require raw XPath or XML request payloads, reducing usability. Porcelain must compile to the existing schema-validated mutation engine and must not introduce another authority store or weaken owner confirmation requirements.

index.summary: Requirement proposal receipt.

acceptance.criterion: Deleting every .agents/work-results/ directory does not affect validation, recovery, review, readiness, or handoff.
A Task can be resumed from tasks.xml with its implementation summary, source commits, checks, findings, review state, risks, blocker, and next action intact.
Raw prompts, chats, mutation envelopes, and provider telemetry are absent from default persisted state.
Large external evidence can be audited through a Task-owned locator and digest without duplicating its bytes in XML.
Git-backed guidance distinguishes document commits from VCS checkpoints and ignores only .dogdouspec/_tmp/ by default.
Handoff reports fail closed when authoritative documents are untracked or dirty relative to the intended checkpoint.
DogdouSpec never performs a Git write without explicit user or repository authority.
Current CLI help documents only implemented commands; proposed porcelain remains labeled as proposed.
Skill sync and workspace initialization generate guidance consistent with these rules.
Owner confirmation remains required for product acceptance and iteration closure.
